prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Flow reorderings, targeted functional hints (photo quality, path decision helper, account security and restore), clean minimal layouts (card carousel, single-click identity), key desktop flows (summon, visibility/control), shortcut hotkey copy, and interactive waiting status updates consistently yielded significant wins.
Harmful changes: Major structural flow overhauls (docking setup, split personality redesign), intrusive spotlight and split view layouts, interactive practice flows, and cheat sheet screens consistently resulted in drops or early test stops.
No effect seen: Dedicated tutorial or environment prep screens, background completion notifications, incentive badges, and static waiting hints or carousels repeatedly showed no statistically clear effect.
Predictions too high: High predicted gains (+8.0% or higher) consistently overstated actual impact, frequently resulting in no clear effect or severe negative performance.
Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially shortcut hotkey copy, account security and restore hints, story reordering, and desktop control flows—far exceeded low or negative predictions.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Recovery Screen: Adds a dedicated screen explaining how to restore pet visibility if it gets obscured behind open desktop windows. (why: Support received multiple complaints about pets not showing on desktop or being lost behind windows.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Identity Safeguard Hint: Adds a clear hint on the sign-in screen informing users that logging in prevents pet profile reset and preserves character data. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Stage Companion Trait Discovery Status: Displays informative trait discovery tips and animated progress indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Home waiting screen has high duration (median 201s, mean 2336s). Active feedback reduces perceived wait time.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Callout: Adds explicit upload instructions on the photo upload screen focusing on facial lighting and background contrast. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or resulting in visual distortion due to bad source images.)
4: [finish, copy] Home Intro Tray Location Copy Clarification: Updates home intro copy to specifically point users to their system tray area where the app icon runs. (why: 3 support emails mentioned pet not appearing on desktop or app failing to open visually after onboarding.)
5: [finish, new_flow] First Launch Desktop Render Verification Flow: Adds a visual verification prompt before final exit to confirm the pet model successfully rendered on the screen. (why: Directly addresses support tickets regarding screen display bugs and missing desktop pet models after setup.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Effort Time Comparison Hint: Adds a helper hint on the choose path screen explicitly stating estimated setup duration for custom vs quick pets. (why: Helps reduce average path selection time (mean 514s) by addressing user uncertainty upfront.)

scores.note: Dedicated prep and recovery screens consistently fail to drive lift or cause drops.
Account security and restore hints are documented high-confidence wins.
Interactive waiting status updates yield reliable gains during long Home step waits.
Photo quality guidance directly recovers users in the highest-drop funnel step.
Clarifying system tray location with key desktop copy improves finish step success.
Desktop verification flow aligns with key desktop control wins but requires new screens.
Path decision helper hints reliably resolve upfront user hesitation.
